___TEMPLATE_NOTE___: This is a TEMPLATE showing cookie structure. Real cookies.json files are NOT committed to Git.
___WARNING___: ⚠️ SENSITIVE DATA: Cookies contain session information and authentication tokens. Never commit real cookies!

___HOW_TO_GET___.step_1: Open website in browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari)
___HOW_TO_GET___.step_5: Select the domain for your website
___HOW_TO_GET___.step_7: Or use a browser extension like 'EditThisCookie' or 'WebCookies'
___HOW_TO_GET___.step_8: Format extracted cookies as JSON array like this template

name: session_id
___name_explanation___: Cookie name/key - identifies what this cookie stores
___value_explanation___: ⚠️ SENSITIVE: Cookie value (could be JWT token, session ID, etc.) - NEVER commit real values!
___domain_explanation___: Domain this cookie applies to - include the dot prefix for subdomains (.example.com applies to all.example.com)
___path_explanation___: Cookie scope - '/' means accessible on entire domain, '/api/' means only under /api/
___expires_explanation___: Expiration time as Unix timestamp (seconds since Jan 1, 1970). Use online converters to verify dates.
___httpOnly_explanation___: true = cookie not accessible from JavaScript (more secure), false = accessible from JS
___secure_explanation___: true = cookie only sent over HTTPS, false = sent over HTTP too
___sameSite_explanation___: Options: 'Strict', 'Lax', 'None'. Controls cookie sending in cross-site requests. 'Strict' is most secure.

___CHATGPT___.note: These are example fields that ChatGPT might use

___CLAUDE___.note: These are example fields that Claude might use

___GENSPARK___.note: These are example fields that GenSpark might use

___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_1: Always use the EXACT values from your browser - don't modify them
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_2: If expires date passed, cookies are invalid - get fresh ones
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_3: Some cookies are for tracking only and might not be needed - try removing optional ones
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_4: httpOnly cookies cannot be accessed via DevTools console - get them from Network tab
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_5: Session cookies (expires=null) expire when browser closes
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_6: Store cookies in data/cookies/ folder - add to .gitignore, never commit real cookies!
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_7: Different adapters might need different cookies from same website
___IMPORTANT_NOTES___.note_8: Refresh cookies periodically if sessions expire frequently

___USAGE_IN_CODE___: How to use cookies in ChatFlow Automator

example_config.description: Point config.json to your cookies file

example_code: from src.chatflow.browser.cookies import CookieManager; manager = CookieManager(); cookies = manager.load_cookies('data/cookies/chatgpt_cookies.json')
